dishes.name: Erdäpfelkas
dishes.desc: Spread of mashed potatoes, sour cream, onion and chives, eaten with bread and smoked meat. Typical in the Bavarian Forest.

dishes.name: Reiberdatschi
dishes.desc: Crisp potato pancake fried in fat, eaten with apple sauce or smoked fish. A Lower Bavarian farm dish.

dishes.name: Schwammerl with dumplings
dishes.desc: Forest mushrooms in cream sauce, served with bread dumplings. Bavarian Forest autumn dish.

dishes.name: Schweinsbraten with Knödel
dishes.desc: Roast pork with crackling, dark beer gravy and potato dumplings. A staple of Niederbayern inns.
